title: Easy Smoky Italian Eggs Stracciatella
description: A smoky and silky Italian dish featuring beef stock concentrate and shio-cure, perfect for a lazy Sunday morning. This kosher-friendly recipe is a twist on the traditional Italian stracciatella.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a fork until the whites and yolks are fully incorporated.
In a small saucepan, combine the beef stock concentrate, shio-cure, smoked paprika, black pepper, and kosher salt, and whisk until smooth.
Add the heavy cream to the saucepan and whisk until fully incorporated.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and let cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the grated grana padano cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the egg mixture to the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, until the eggs are just set.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the stracciatella hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
